items.title: Normalize Provider connections and decouple code growth readiness
items.value: Give Qwen, Grok, and DeepSeek independent bounded connection strategies while preserving one canonical completion contract and allowing honest single-provider code growth.
acceptance: vendor HTTP, credentials, probes, structured-output strategies, and error classification remain inside independent connectors
connection receipts contain no credentials and old blocked evidence remains immutable
Provider selection requires fair evidence but does not globally block builders when one eligible Provider exists
repository codegen, capability building, and self-growth preserve CapabilityTree, ExecutionDAG, admission, and fallback-deny authorities

items.title: Grow the first real Research and Release capability leaves
items.value: Use the admitted Self-Growth path to generate bounded public-network and deterministic release capabilities without manually implementing business executors.
acceptance: READ_ONLY_PUBLIC_NETWORK is credential-free, SSRF-protected, redirect-revalidated, and bounded
web.fetch.public@1 is generated and admitted only through the bounded network runtime
github.repo.inspect.public@1 depends on an executable web.fetch.public@1
release.notes.from_diff@1 is generated, admitted, executed, and reused
all Provider work stays within eight calls and Full regression remains out of policy

items.title: Complete repository MVP reset
items.value: Remove obsolete active authorities and make the CapabilityTree MVP the only current product direction.
acceptance: obsolete fixed-flow authorities are outside active paths
historical material is removed from the working tree and remains recoverable from Git history
orphaned branch-agent, full-dynamic resume, scale, and long-test diagnostics are removed
cleanup boundary is machine-readable
cleanup remains on an isolated non-force branch

items.title: Wire the common Block execution boundary
items.value: Make the Component/Block contract executable through one replaceable bounded Executor interface.
acceptance: canonical execution request and result contracts
typed declared inputs and outputs
replaceable Executor adapter protocol
deterministic local-action adapter
ExecutionDAG coordinator executes ready nodes
run and result state are persisted
focused tests execute a real node without Provider-owned project planning

items.title: Finish CapabilityTree composition semantics
items.value: Let the high-capability Agent incrementally create and modify a stable composition tree.
acceptance: stable node identity
structural parent-child composition
add, replace, remove, and expand operations
roles remain optional views over capabilities

items.title: Finish Tree-to-DAG compilation
items.value: Compile executable dependencies separately from the human-readable composition tree.
acceptance: fan-out and fan-in
cycle and unknown-dependency rejection
deterministic topological order
no second execution graph authority

items.title: Create replaceable executor adapters
items.value: Run bounded Blocks through cheap models, local models, APIs, search, scripts, browsers, and deterministic tools.
acceptance: common execute contract
bounded task packet
cost, timeout, and provenance metadata
executor cannot redefine project intent

items.title: Persist project and run state
items.value: Keep goals, tree, DAG, node results, artifacts, failures, and checkpoints without replaying full conversation history.
acceptance: identity-bound project state
node execution history
artifact and result references
safe resume after interruption

items.title: Prove one real vertical slice
items.value: Complete one real project change through the new tree, DAG, executor, test, and state path.
acceptance: real repository or project input
CapabilityTree and compiled DAG recorded
real code or project change
real test or runtime result
high-capability Agent calls measured

items.title: Implement affected-subgraph repair
items.value: Map failures to the smallest safe node/subgraph and rerun only affected work.
acceptance: failure-to-node mapping
downstream invalidation
unaffected results reused
no default whole-project regeneration

items.title: Build the capability registry
items.value: Allow the Agent to discover capabilities by interface, constraints, cost, executor, and observed quality.
acceptance: queryable capability metadata
versioned interface identity
test and usage evidence
reuse before new implementation

items.title: Prove first validated self-growth
items.value: Discover, integrate, test, register, and reuse one previously missing capability.
acceptance: capability gap detected
library, API, or tool search performed
bounded trial passes
new Block is registered and reused

items.title: Add project-team views
items.value: Expose PM, Developer, Tester, Researcher, Release, and Marketing as capability bundles over the same kernel.
acceptance: no mandatory role chain
role composition reuses registered capabilities
one project uses only the roles it needs

items.title: Add promotion and publishing capabilities
items.value: Extend the project team into content, media, social publishing, feedback, and metrics without another pipeline system.
acceptance: promotion actions are Blocks
connectors are replaceable
publishing requires explicit authorization
results feed project state

items.title: Integrate high-capability Agent and bounded cheap LLM executor
items.value: Let the Agent make sparse composition and repair decisions while a cheaper model performs bounded node work.
acceptance: Agent decisions compile to validated TreeEdits
cheap model proposals are strict and deterministically applied
Agent and worker model roles are separately configured
a real provider vertical slice edits code and passes pytest
failure repair and escalation remain bounded

items.title: Freeze and complete the kernel foundation
items.value: Make every current kernel layer fail-closed, tested, mapped, and governed before adding leaves.
acceptance: single authorities
complete source-to-test mapping
static, unit, boundary, and local-functional profiles
foundation vertical slice
independent kernel completeness status

items.title: Build the first L6 software project generation bundle
items.value: Generate and externally validate real local software projects through existing kernel authorities and bounded file-scoped workers.
acceptance: deterministic L6 contracts and hidden acceptance harness pass
one real CLI project passes within fixed Provider and repair budgets
the CLI repeats 3/3 before Web, API, and seeded repair authorize higher generation readiness
no generated candidate is manually edited

items.title: Select a canonical semantic artifact interface
items.value: Replace prompt-coupled L6 coordination with validated contract, state, evidence, interface, and repair facts chosen through a fair A/B/C experiment.
acceptance: three complete designs pass the same deterministic and fake-provider contract suite
real Provider comparison uses identical models, budgets, cases, hidden acceptance, and independent workspaces
winner selection uses the fixed 100-point rubric and hard qualification threshold
only a qualified winner may change production L6 semantics
Kernel foundation remains COMPLETE and candidate projects receive zero manual edits

items.title: Compile requirements into traceable executable obligations
items.value: Prevent Agent, Worker, public tests, and hidden acceptance from applying different interpretations of the same user requirement, while preserving a direct high-capability route for small tasks.
acceptance: ratcheted Kernel/Application/Experiment baselines prevent silent regression
dependency and error semantics are typed and source-traceable
public and hidden tests have 100% obligation traceability
direct Agent and composed DAG routes are compared under equal facts and budgets
semantic A/B/C comparison resumes only after the obligation layer meets the CLI threshold

items.title: Integrate the independent local multi-model Provider gateway
items.value: Route high-capability Agent and bounded Worker calls through independently managed Qwen, DeepSeek, or Grok providers without moving credentials or authority into CGKN.
acceptance: GatewayCompletionClient preserves the CompletionClient contract and the old client remains the default
one immutable run snapshot routes Agent to qwen and Worker to deepseek with fallback denied
the existing budget ledger rejects excess work before transport and records unavailable usage honestly
a real seeded project traverses Agent, CapabilityTree, DAG, bounded Worker, pytest, snapshot, and external acceptance through HTTP mock gateway
Grok can replace either role by configuration without CapabilityTree or DAG changes

items.title: Evaluate and select Providers by task-specific evidence
items.value: Benchmark allowed Providers fairly, aggregate task-specific capability profiles, select deterministically, and freeze routing before each run.
acceptance: at least two Providers produce eligible real evidence
agent.composition, worker.codegen, and worker.repair have evidence-based winners
unknown cost is never treated as zero
run routing is immutable and fallback remains deny

items.title: Validate local-lazy knowledge growth and internalization
items.value: Preserve raw evidence while classifying updates, invalidating only dependent abstractions, refreshing derived knowledge on demand, and measuring maintenance cost as the knowledge pack grows.
acceptance: exact duplicate ingestion performs zero model calls and no derived rebuild
support, novel, supersession, contradiction, correction, retraction, and unresolved relations are auditable
leaf changes invalidate only actual dependent abstractions and never force immediate global recomputation
Conversation excludes stale abstractions and can retrieve updated raw evidence with preserved provenance
100, 1000, and 5000 entry comparisons report write, retrieval, context, recomputation, and model-call costs for flat, eager, and local-lazy policies

items.title: Measure ProjectKnowledgePack persistence and retrieval scaling
items.value: Separate logical local-lazy behavior from physical persistence, cold-start, memory, and retrieval costs before authorizing a storage redesign.
acceptance: real filesystem and new-process measurements cover 1k, 5k, 10k, 50k, 100k, and resource-safe 250k
uniform, hot-branch, and long-tail corpora preserve fixed-query correctness and restart equivalence
physical write and serialization amplification are reported separately from node-level invalidation
S0/S1/S2/S3 research preserves one logical authority and tests corruption behavior
any production redesign remains backward-compatible and starts in a separate follow-up

items.title: Improve evidence-backed strong escalation without new authority
items.value: Close strong-token and pricing uncertainty on bounded decision workloads before considering adaptive routing as a default or collapsing the retained coordinator/worker boundary.
acceptance: all compared routes return complete usage and pricing evidence or are explicitly excluded from percentage claims
adaptive routing preserves critical-stop correctness and reliability against strong-all
strong tokens per successful decision fall by at least the declared gate without increasing false or missed escalation
no new Agent, planner, runtime, DAG, state, Knowledge, or Capability authority is introduced
Blueprint or role-boundary changes require a separate source closure and new real generation/repair evidence
